cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Three more departments to cover! My influence is spreading.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Excellent. I'll have a presence in every department.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! Put the department names on it; they'll see how far my jurisdiction extends.

confusable: Not simple optimism: every burden is evidence of wider influence, not just a useful solution.
comparison: Unfunded departments/mobile desk versus investigation/laundry correspondence.
